title: The scene-to-elements half of drawing lives in the compositor
body:
`draw.rs` builds `Scene` and `Shape` and owns `TextCache`. `Paint::scene` and `Shrink` in `compositor.rs`, about 115 lines, turn the shapes into smithay render elements. `Scene.shapes`, `Shape` and the fields of `TextTexture` are `pub` only for that, and `round_trip` is `pub` with no outside caller. Inside `Paint::scene`, the `Rect` arm premultiplies inline while the `Rounded` arm defines a `premultiply` closure for the same arithmetic.

## Proposal

Move `Paint`, `Shrink` and the shape-to-element match into `draw.rs` so one module owns drawing end to end, with `Element` passed in or moved along. Do "Fonts and the text cache get one home" and the border width bug first. Mostly moved lines, few deleted.
